name: vscode-worktree-manager
description: Worktrees, Linear issues and pull requests in one switcher, with per-repo bootstrap hooks

virtualWorkspaces.description: Needs a real filesystem and the git binary.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Runs git commands in the opened folder.

aistos.hooks.postCreate.markdownDescription: Shell command run after a worktree is created, from the primary worktree. Receives `WORKTREE_PATH`, `WORKTREE_BRANCH`, `WORKTREE_SOURCE` and `WORKTREE_PURPOSE` in its environment. Empty disables it. Set this in the repo's `.vscode/settings.json` so it travels with the repo.

aistos.hooks.preDelete.markdownDescription: Shell command run **before** a worktree is deleted, from the primary worktree. A non-zero exit aborts the deletion, so a failed teardown cannot leave the worktree removed and its stack running. Empty disables it.

aistos.linear.workspace.markdownDescription: Your Linear workspace slug — the `<workspace>` in `https://linear.app/<workspace>/issue/A-1661`. Required to build issue links, and not derivable: nothing in an issue identifier yields it, and team keys are unique only within a workspace. Empty disables every Linear feature.

aistos.linear.openIn.markdownDescription: Open Linear issues in the browser (`https://`) or the desktop app (`linear://`).

aistos.linear.clientId.markdownDescription:
OAuth application client id from `linear.app/settings/api/applications/new`. Set it and sign-in uses OAuth with PKCE; leave it empty and sign-in asks for a personal API key instead.

Register the redirect URI as exactly `http://127.0.0.1:47823/callback`. A client id is public by design — there is no secret to configure, because PKCE makes one unnecessary and a `.vsix` could not keep one anyway.

aistos.linear.setStartedOnCreate.markdownDescription: Move a Linear issue to its team's first started status when a worktree is created for it — only when the issue is currently in triage, backlog or unstarted, so an issue already In Review is never dragged backwards. Defaults to **off**: it needs a write-capable credential, and that should be a choice you make rather than one a default install makes for you.

aistos.linear.teamKeys.markdownDescription: Team keys this workspace issues, e.g. `["A"]`. When set, a branch whose prefix is not one of them yields no badge — which is what stops `wip-2-something` rendering a confident link to a non-existent `WIP-2`. Empty accepts any identifier-shaped prefix.

aistos.worktreesRoot.markdownDescription: Where new worktrees are created. Empty resolves to `<parent of the primary worktree>/worktrees`. `~` is expanded.

nonce.description: Identifies one hook run, so its exit code can be matched back.

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external vscode --minify
scripts.dev: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external vscode --watch
scripts.package: bun run build && bun x @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license
